tables.name: sla_policy_revisions
columns: contract_product_line_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES contract_product_lines(contract_product_line_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
template_source TEXT NULL CHECK(template_source IS NULL OR template_source IN ('IT_DEFAULT_V1','NFV_DEFAULT_V1'))
created_command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: policy revision applies live to every currently classified SR when selected as CPL current policy regardless of SR Report Date/terminality

tables.name: sla_policy_tiers
columns: policy_revision_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sla_policy_revisions(policy_revision_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(severity IN ('critical','major','minor','non_fault_inquiry'))
required_percentage_millionths INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(required_percentage_millionths BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000)
derived_from_tier_id TEXT NULL REFERENCES sla_policy_tiers(policy_tier_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
derivation_num INTEGER NULL CHECK(derivation_num IS NULL OR derivation_num>0)
derivation_den INTEGER NULL CHECK(derivation_den IS NULL OR derivation_den>0)

CHECK((severity='non_fault_inquiry' AND derived_from_tier_id IS NOT NULL AND derivation_num=3 AND derivation_den=2) OR (severity<>'non_fault_inquiry' AND derived_from_tier_id IS NULL AND derivation_num IS NULL AND derivation_den IS NULL))
rules: tier fraction is reduced by gcd before insert
maximum duration is an exact rational number of seconds; no floating-point representation
base accepted policy defines Critical/Major/Minor tiers; Non-fault inquiry tiers are generated from Minor tiers by exact 3/2 multiplication preserving percentage and ordinal structure
same severity may own several ordered tiers such as IT Major 85%/15d then 100%/30d

required_indexes: all command/FK columns receive LLD-01 leading-prefix FK coverage

template_registry.rule: templates are immutable code definitions and have no SLA authority until Create/RevisePolicy explicitly materializes them under one Contract Product Line; Non-fault rows are generated from Minor during validation/materialization

current_pointer_rule: contract_product_lines.current_policy_revision_id must reference a revision belonging to that exact CPL. Policy revision insert and current-pointer advance occur atomically; prior revision/tier rows remain immutable.
